cells.old: Fillable EXCLUSIVELY by legal persons that are exonerated from employer contributions under ET art. 114-1. Bidirectional pair with 'Self-withholding rate' (casilla 28), which the DIAN service derives automatically once 27 is chosen.
cells.new: Fillable EXCLUSIVELY by legal persons that are exonerated from employer contributions under ET art. 114-1. Related to 'Self-withholding rate' (casilla 28), which is disabled from the June 2026 period (DIAN Oficio 15662 of 2026).

cells.old: Derived automatically by the DIAN service from 'Self-withholding activity code' (casilla 27); cannot be keyed independently. Bidirectional pair with casilla 27.
cells.new: Disabled from the June 2026 period: requires no entry (DIAN Oficio 15662 of 2026). Previously derived automatically by the DIAN service from 'Self-withholding activity code' (casilla 27) and not keyable independently.

cells.old: The self-withholding rate for the chosen activity, applied to ALL payments received. Set by DUR 1625 de 2016 art. 1.2.6.8. Not a payroll figure - it applies to the employer's own income, not to its employees.
cells.new: DISABLED from the June 2026 period: the Consejo de Estado provisionally suspended arts. 2 to 8 of Decree 572 of 2025 on 7 May 2026, and DIAN Oficio 15662 of 2026 states 'la casilla 28 correspondiente a la tarifa (%) se encuentra deshabilitada y no requiere diligenciamiento'. Do not populate. The rate was formerly set by DUR 1625 de 2016 art. 1.2.6.8 and applied to ALL payments received. Not a payroll figure - it applies to the employer's own income, not to its employees.

cells.new: 27 Economic activity principal (CIIU) | 28 Rate (disabled from the June 2026 period; not populated)

cells.old: Derived by the portal from the CIIU code chosen in casilla 27.
cells.new: Disabled from the June 2026 period (DIAN Oficio 15662 of 2026); not populated. Until then it was derived by the portal from the CIIU code chosen in casilla 27.

cells.old: From casilla 46 of the RUT, per DIAN Resoluciones 000114 of 21 December 2020, 001232 of 16 September 2022 and 000086 of 24 May 2023. The chosen code drives the self-withholding rate auto-filled into casilla 28 under DUR 1625 de 2016 art. 1.2.6.8.
cells.new: From casilla 46 of the RUT, per DIAN Resoluciones 000114 of 21 December 2020, 001232 of 16 September 2022 and 000086 of 24 May 2023. Until the May 2026 period the chosen code drove the self-withholding rate auto-filled into casilla 28 under DUR 1625 de 2016 art. 1.2.6.8; casilla 28 is disabled from the June 2026 period (DIAN Oficio 15662 of 2026).

cells.old: The DIAN service derives casillas 28 (from 27), 55, 56, 57, 58, 109, 110, 111 and 112 (from the sheet-2 annex totals 148 to 155), 130, 134, 136, 138 and 147 (145 x 146). Supply only the inputs. Attempting to key a derived casilla either fails or, worse, creates an inconsistency the portal silently overwrites.
cells.new: The DIAN service derives casillas 55, 56, 57, 58, 109, 110, 111 and 112 (from the sheet-2 annex totals 148 to 155), 130, 134, 136, 138 and 147 (145 x 146). Supply only the inputs. Attempting to key a derived casilla either fails or, worse, creates an inconsistency the portal silently overwrites.

cells.old: Casilla 28 is derived from casilla 27 by the portal. Supply 27 only.
cells.new: From the June 2026 period casilla 28 is disabled and requires no entry (DIAN Oficio 15662 of 2026; provisional suspension of arts. 2 to 8 of Decree 572 of 2025 by the Consejo de Estado on 7 May 2026). Leave casilla 28 blank and populate casilla 27 as described in its own row.

cells.old: A hard-coded rate in 28 will be overwritten and may mask a wrong CIIU code in 27.
cells.new: Do not key a rate in 28: it is disabled from the June 2026 period.
